events.title: On Your Own: Demo Released
events.summary: The game is fully functional.The player has a limited map to explore and Then a limited access to all loot type.The possibilities of "end" a run are too low, but, if your are lucky and the randomness gods bless you, you may exit from "Remote Island"I am looking forward for your feedback.Hope you enjoy it.

events.title: All new Open Beta reopened for test.
